node.date_label: L’Histoire en miettes (1987) · La marche des idées (2003) · Le pari biographique (2005) · “L’histoire entre la guerre des mémoires et la Justice” (2017)
node.description: A historian of historiography, intellectual life and biography. His retrospective account of L’Histoire en miettes presents its critique of histories that foreground permanence at the expense of events, subjects and change; he also states that his own earlier theoretical position changed. In a later primary article he distinguishes historical explanation, public remembrance and judicial judgment. The entry treats those distinctions as his methodological intervention, while keeping his descriptions of law and legal institutions within their historical publication context.
